31:   // Simple collision (circle–rectangle for ship)
32:   function rectCircleCollide(rect, cx, cy, cr) {
33:     const dx = Math.max(rect.x, Math.min(cx, rect.x + rect.w));
34:     const dy = Math.max(rect.y, Math.min(cy, rect.y + rect.h));
35:     const dist = Math.hypot(dx - cx, dy - cy);

37:   }

44:     else ship.speedY = 0;
45:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - ship.h, ship.y + ship.speedY));
46: 
47:     // Move asteroids & fuels

49:     fuels.forEach(f => (f.x += f.vx));
50:     // Remove off‑screen objects

64:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
65:       }
66:     }
67: 
68:     // Consume fuel over time
69:     fuel -= 0.05;
70:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
71:     score += 0.1;
72:   }
73:

75:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

77:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
78:     ctx.beginPath();
79:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
80:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);

87:     // Fuel cells

90:     // HUD
91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
92:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
93:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
94:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(fuel)}%`, 10, 40);
95:     if (gameOver) {
96:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
97:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
98:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
99:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
100:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
101:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
102:     }
103:   }
104: 
105:   function loop() {
106:     update();
107:     draw();
108:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
109:   }
110: 
111:   // Spawn timers
112:   setInterval(spawnAsteroid, 1500);
113:   setInterval(spawnFuel, 4000);
114: 
115:   // Start
116:   loop();
117: })();
